description: This is a Python source file for a voice assistant bot implementation that integrates various modules such as speech-to-text, text-to-speech, language model services, and custom tools for weather and restaurant recommendations. It defines functions, creates tool schemas, configures a processing pipeline, and manages event handlers for client connections and transcript updates.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Schema for defining callable functions with description, parameters, and required fields.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Schema grouping multiple function tools for use in the bot.

classes.name: SileroVADAnalyzer
classes.description: Voice activity detection analyzer using Silero models.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Frame representing a language model run within the pipeline.

classes.name: TranscriptionMessage
classes.description: Message object for transcribed speech, including timestamp, role, and content.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines a processing pipeline comprising multiple processing steps.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution of the pipeline, including signal handling and frame queueing.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the pipeline, such as metrics and usage collection.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Represents a task which encapsulates the pipeline and its execution parameters.

classes.name: OpenAILLMContext
classes.description: Context object for managing interactions with OpenAI's language models.

classes.name: TranscriptProcessor
classes.description: Processes transcriptions from speech-to-text modules and handles events.

classes.name: SessionProperties
classes.description: Session configuration settings for the LLM service, including modalities and turn detection.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api(params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch weather data based on input parameters.

methods.name: fetch_restaurant_recommendation(params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Asynchronous function to get restaurant recommendations.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Sets up and runs the pipeline-based voice assistant with given transport and runtime arguments.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point function for initiating the bot with runner arguments.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Standard script entry point invoking the main runner.
